# Working of RIGHT JOIN

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## Working of RIGHT JOIN

![Right and Left Tables](data:image/png;base64,)

Here,

- The RIGHT JOIN keyword joins the Customers and Orders tables.
- The ON keyword specifies the join condition (Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id), ensuring all rows from Orders and matching rows from Customers are included.

Let's explore some examples of RIGHT JOIN.
